title: GAFC: Kitchen Counter Conundrum
body:
🛡️🍗 🛡️🍗 Yo, GAFC Fam! Let's get into some real talk that keeps our communities strong and safe. 💪 Gloxsie 21 always preaches, 'A secure firearm is a responsible firearm.' But sometimes, even the best of us (lookin' at you, Bobo Licious 👀) need a quick safety check.

Imagine this: Bobo just finished a great session at the range, feeling sharp. He gets home, puts his piece down on the kitchen counter 'for just a minute' to grab some of that leftover fried chicken. Suddenly, his curious little cousin, who’s visiting, toddles into the kitchen, eyes bright and hands reaching.

Now, we all know things can go left fast. Gloxsie 21 is giving Bobo the serious side-eye. What's the *only* right move for Bobo here?

A) Immediately secure the firearm in its locked storage, out of reach, then have an age-appropriate conversation with the family about gun safety rules.
B) Grab the firearm and stash it under a pillow in the bedroom, 'just for now.'
C) Yell at the kid to not touch anything, then continue grabbing snacks.
D) Assume the kid won't touch it because he's 'been told before.'

This ain't just about 'rules,' it's about protecting our legacy and our future. What's your answer, GAFC Fam? Drop a A, B, C, or D in the comments and let's discuss respectfully! 👇 Swipe over to our stories to see the poll results and hear Gloxsie's real talk!

Remember what Pastor Jenkins from Church of Legacy says: 'Our faith calls us to be guardians of our families and our future. Safety is a divine responsibility.'

#GAFCSafety #GunSafetyEducation #CommunityFirst #ResponsibleGunOwner #ProtectOurKids #SafeStorage #StreetSmartSafety #GlocksAndFriedChicken
